instruction: Please help me enable format on save in VS Code.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"editor.formatOnSave": false}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "editor.formatOnSave" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"editor.formatOnSave": false/"editor.formatOnSave": false/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"editor.formatOnSave": false}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling format on save in VS Code by changing from false to true. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings function to verify the editor.formatOnSave setting in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VS Code settings file from standard Linux path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly verifies that editor.formatOnSave key exists and equals true
Expected value is semantically correct: true enables format on save as required by instruction
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (enable format on save) which is fully verified
Edge cases handled: metric handles missing files, parsing errors, and missing keys with sentinel pattern
State accessibility is guaranteed: settings.json persists after VS Code closes, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: getter extracts right state → metric checks right aspect → expected value matches requirement
